faq.q: What is Learn With Why?
faq.a: Learn With Why creates printable activity sheets and worksheets for young learners. The website focuses on playful practice, clear layouts and curiosity.
alt: What does your website do?
Tell me about Learn With Why

faq.q: Who are these resources for?
faq.a: They are designed for families, teachers, tutors and schools supporting early learning. Choose the relevant account role when prompted.
alt: Can parents and teachers use this website?

faq.q: Which classes are available?
faq.a: Kindergarten resources are available in the uploaded website. Class 1, Class 2 and Class 3 are marked Coming soon. Check the current shop for any later additions.
alt: Do you have Class 1 worksheets?
Are Class 2 and Class 3 available?

faq.q: Are Class 1 worksheets ready?
faq.a: Class 1 is marked Coming soon in this website. You can explore the Kindergarten collection while new resources are being prepared.

faq.q: Are Class 2 worksheets ready?
faq.a: Class 2 is marked Coming soon in this website. No release date is confirmed in the supplied files.

faq.q: Are Class 3 worksheets ready?
faq.a: Class 3 is marked Coming soon in this website. No release date is confirmed in the supplied files.

faq.q: Which subjects are listed?
faq.a: The shop lists English, Maths and Science filters. The current ready-to-open worksheet collection in the uploaded build is focused on Kindergarten English and alphabet skills; a subject label does not guarantee that resources are available in it.
alt: Do you have English, Maths and Science?

faq.q: Are these digital resources or physical books?
faq.a: The website shop presents printable digital PDF sheets opened through a protected viewer. Contact support separately about physical books mentioned in customer testimonials.
alt: Will you deliver a printed book?
Do I receive a PDF?

faq.q: What makes these worksheets different?
faq.a: The website describes sheets built around a single learning idea, with clear guide lines, generous white space and an ink-friendly layout.

faq.q: Are teachers involved in the design?
faq.a: The website says that early-years teachers try the pages in classrooms and provide feedback before publication.

faq.q: How do I find worksheets?
faq.a: Open the shop or Sheets section, choose Kindergarten, and browse the available topics. Tap a sheet to see its description and access options.
alt: Where is the worksheet collection?
How do I open the shop?

faq.q: How do I filter by class?
faq.a: Use the Classes list in the shop. Kindergarten currently contains the available collection; Class 1–3 are marked Coming soon.

faq.q: How do I filter by subject?
faq.a: Use the Subjects list in the shop and select English, Maths or Science. If no resources appear, try another filter or check again later.

faq.q: How do I find free sheets?
faq.a: Choose the Free view in the shop. Eight sheets are free to try: Alphabet A and Alphabet B tracing, and the first three Colours and first three Shapes sheets in Vocabulary. Pick Free in the shop and tap Open it free. No sign-in is needed. Every other sheet is bought on its own or opens with a class plan.
alt: Show me the free worksheets

faq.q: What does Bestselling mean?
faq.a: Bestselling is a shop view for highlighted popular resources. Open a listed sheet to inspect its content and price.

faq.q: What does Coming soon mean?
faq.a: The topic or class is listed but its resources are not yet ready in this build. A release date is not provided.

faq.q: Why are no worksheets showing?
faq.a: A class, subject or topic filter may have no available resources. Try All sheets or Kindergarten, and check whether the selected section is marked Coming soon.

faq.q: Can I preview a worksheet before buying?
faq.a: Tap the worksheet card to see its preview and description. Full protected access requires signing in and having the relevant free, purchased or subscription entitlement.

faq.q: How many worksheets are free?
faq.a: Eight sheets are free to try: Alphabet A and Alphabet B tracing, and the first three Colours and first three Shapes sheets in Vocabulary. Pick Free in the shop and tap Open it free. No sign-in is needed. Every other sheet is bought on its own or opens with a class plan.
alt: Are all worksheets free?
Which two sheets are free?
Which sheets are free?
Free sheets
What is free?

faq.q: Is the entire A–Z alphabet collection free?
faq.a: No. Alphabet A and B tracing are the free alphabet samples (plus the first three Colours and first three Shapes sheets in Vocabulary). The remaining letters are paid unless your active class plan gives you access.
alt: Are all 26 letters free?
Is Alphabet C free?

faq.q: Do I need an account to open free sheets?
faq.a: Yes. Select Open it free on a free sheet. No account or sign-in is needed. Printing a free sheet needs a free account.
alt: Can I open free PDFs without login?

faq.q: Do I need to pay to create an account?
faq.a: The website offers a free account. Paid worksheet purchases and class subscriptions are separate.

faq.q: How do I open Alphabet A or Alphabet B?
faq.a: Open the Free shop view or the A–Z tracing section, choose Alphabet A or B, then select Open it free. No sign-in is needed. The sheet opens in the protected viewer.

faq.q: What does a free account include?
faq.a: The signup prompt lists access to free sheets in the full-screen viewer, resource suggestions and customer support. Paid sheets still need a purchase or a relevant class subscription.

faq.q: How do I create an account?
faq.a: Use Sign up on the home page: enter your name and email, choose Parent, Teacher or Organization, and tick the rules. We email you a 6-digit code. Type it on the website to finish. No password is needed.
alt: How do I sign up?
How do I register?

faq.q: Will I receive a password by email?
faq.a: No. There are no passwords. Every time you sign up or sign in, we email you a fresh 6-digit code. The email has only the code, never a link.
alt: Where do I get my generated password?

faq.q: How do I confirm my email address?
faq.a: Open the confirmation link sent to your registered email. If sign-in says your email is unverified, use Send the email again.

faq.q: I did not receive my code. What should I do?
faq.a: Wait a minute and check Spam or Junk. Make sure the email address is right (use Change email if not). After 60 seconds you can press Send a new code. If it still does not arrive, contact learnwithwhy6@gmail.com.

faq.q: How do I sign in?
faq.a: Select Sign in, type your registered email and press Email me a code. Type the 6-digit code from the email to sign in.
alt: How do I log in?

faq.q: Why does login say my email is unverified?
faq.a: Your email confirmation has not been completed or recognized. Open the confirmation link in your email, or use Send the email again and retry.

faq.q: I forgot my password. How can I reset it?
faq.a: There is no password to forget. Select Sign in, type your email and we send you a 6-digit code to sign in.
alt: How do I recover my password?

faq.q: How long does a sign-in code work?
faq.a: A code works once, for a short time (about 10 minutes). If it has expired, press Send a new code and use the newest email.

faq.q: The website says my code is wrong. What should I do?
faq.a: Check that you typed the 6 numbers from the newest email. Older codes stop working when a new one is sent. After too many wrong tries, wait a few minutes and ask for a new code.

faq.q: Why is there no link in the email?
faq.a: For safety our emails carry only a 6-digit code, never a link to click. Type the code on the website.

faq.q: Which account roles can I choose?
faq.a: The account screen lists Parent, Teacher, Tutor and School. Select the role that describes who the resources are for.

faq.q: Can I change my account role?
faq.a: The signed-in account card includes a Change option beside the role. Use it to select the correct role. Confirm any licence or pricing consequences with support.

faq.q: How do I sign out?
faq.a: Use Sign out in the signed-in account card. Sign out after using a shared or public computer.

faq.q: What does Keep me signed in do?
faq.a: It asks the website to keep your sign-in available between visits, subject to session expiry. Leave it unchecked on a shared or public device.

faq.q: Where can I find my worksheets?
faq.a: Open My Account → My Worksheets. The current website also uses the Cart drawer to show free sheets you opened, purchased PDFs and resources in an active class plan.
alt: Where are my purchased PDFs?
Where is My Worksheets?

faq.q: My session ended. What should I do?
faq.a: Sign in again with your registered email and the 6-digit code we email you, then return to My Worksheets or the sheet you were opening.

faq.q: What is a class subscription?
faq.a: A class subscription opens the available sheets in the selected class while the plan is active. An individual PDF purchase is a separate access option.
alt: How does a subscription work?

faq.q: Which class can I subscribe to?
faq.a: The uploaded website offers the Kindergarten collection and marks Class 1–3 Coming soon. Use the current shop to check which class plans can actually be purchased.

faq.q: Which subscription durations are offered in India?
faq.a: The uploaded checkout offers 1-month, 3-month and 6-month plans in India.

faq.q: Is there a 12-month subscription?
faq.a: The uploaded website offers a 12-month option outside India, alongside 1, 3 and 6 months. The India checkout excludes the 12-month plan.

faq.q: How do I subscribe?
faq.a: Sign in, open the shop Subscription view, choose the available class and plan, complete your billing details, and pay using an enabled payment method.

faq.q: Does a subscription include every class?
faq.a: The website describes subscriptions per class. A Kindergarten plan opens eligible Kindergarten sheets while it is active; it does not promise access to every class.

faq.q: How is a subscription different from buying one PDF?
faq.a: A class plan provides access to its sheets while the plan runs. The uploaded website describes an individually purchased PDF as yours to keep with no expiry, subject to account and licence conditions.

faq.q: Can I renew before my plan ends?
faq.a: Yes. The website says you can renew while a plan is active and the new plan starts when the current plan ends. Confirm the start and end dates shown at checkout.

faq.q: What happens when my subscription expires?
faq.a: Access supplied by that class plan ends when the plan expires. A PDF bought on its own has its own timer: it stays open for a set number of hours (24 unless the shop says otherwise), then it is removed from your account. Check My Account → My Worksheets for the time left.

faq.q: Does buying one PDF create a subscription?
faq.a: No. The website offers individual PDF purchases and class subscriptions as different choices. Review the order summary before paying.

faq.q: Can I buy just one worksheet?
faq.a: Yes. Open its card and choose Buy this PDF, then complete checkout. A class subscription is optional.
alt: Do I have to subscribe?

faq.q: How do I buy a paid PDF?
faq.a: Sign in, select the sheet, choose Buy this PDF, complete your billing address, and pay through an enabled method. Access opens after the payment is verified.

faq.q: Why does checkout ask for my country and billing address?
faq.a: Checkout uses your country and billing details to prepare a price quote and the applicable checkout fields. India checkout requests state and a six-digit PIN code.

faq.q: Which billing details are needed in India?
faq.a: The current India checkout asks for country, street address, city, state and a six-digit PIN code. Follow any additional required fields shown on the payment page.

faq.q: What is a coupon code?
faq.a: A coupon code may apply a discount when accepted by checkout. Enter the code and choose Apply; check the updated total before paying.

faq.q: My coupon code is invalid. What should I do?
faq.a: Check its spelling and any conditions supplied with the offer. If checkout still rejects it, contact support. The uploaded files do not establish a particular coupon as currently valid.

faq.q: When does paid worksheet access open?
faq.a: The website says access opens when payment is verified. Check the purchase-success message and My Worksheets after confirmation.

faq.q: What should I see after a successful purchase?
faq.a: The purchase popup confirms completion and provides options such as Open the PDF now and Open My Worksheets. Subscription purchases show the relevant plan period.

faq.q: How do I open a PDF?
faq.a: Sign in, choose an unlocked worksheet from My Worksheets or its shop card, then select Open PDF. It opens in the protected viewer in a new tab.

faq.q: Why does the PDF open in a new tab?
faq.a: The website opens worksheets in a separate protected viewer. Close that tab to return to the shop.

faq.q: Why does the worksheet show my name?
faq.a: The uploaded website says the protected viewer adds a watermark with your name to identify your licensed access.

faq.q: Can I open a paid PDF without signing in?
faq.a: No. Sign in to the account with the purchase or relevant active plan so the website can check access.

faq.q: Can I send the PDF link to another person?
faq.a: A protected access link is tied to authorised access. Do not share your credentials or use a protected link to distribute paid resources. Ask support about an appropriate classroom or school licence.

faq.q: What if the PDF tab does not open?
faq.a: Allow the site to open its viewer tab, make sure you are signed in, and retry from My Worksheets. If access is still denied, check your purchase or plan status and contact support.

faq.q: Can I download the original PDF file?
faq.a: The supplied website describes protected viewing rather than a guaranteed unrestricted file download. Use the controls available in the viewer and ask support if you need clarification about downloads.

faq.q: Which paper size should I use?
faq.a: The listed ready worksheet resources are A4 pages. The general website copy also mentions US Letter printing; check the viewer and print preview before printing.

faq.q: Are the worksheets suitable for black-and-white printing?
faq.a: The website describes its resources as ink-friendly and black-and-white friendly. Check the selected sheet preview for any activity that specifically uses colours.

faq.q: How should I set up my printer?
faq.a: Choose the paper size matching the sheet, use the correct portrait or landscape orientation, and check print preview. Fit to page can help if the printer cuts off the edges.

faq.q: Can teachers use the sheets in a classroom?
faq.a: The site includes a Teacher role and classroom use. Use the licence that matches your intended use, and confirm the permitted copies or distribution with support.

faq.q: Can tutors or schools use the resources?
faq.a: The site includes Tutor and School roles. Choose the relevant role and confirm the applicable licence and permitted use with support.

faq.q: How do I contact support?
faq.a: Email learnwithwhy6@gmail.com or use the contact form in the Contact us section.
alt: What is your support email?
How can I contact you?

faq.q: What details do I enter in the contact form?
faq.a: Enter your name, email address and message, then choose Send a little note. Use an email address where you can receive the reply.

faq.q: How quickly will support reply?
faq.a: The uploaded contact-form confirmation says the team replies within one working day. Treat this as the website’s stated response target, not a guaranteed immediate reply.

faq.q: Can I request a new worksheet?
faq.a: Yes. The free-account prompt invites resource suggestions. Use the contact form or email support and describe the class, topic and learning need.

faq.q: What should I include when reporting a purchase problem?
faq.a: Include your registered email, worksheet or plan name, order or payment reference if available, and a short description of the issue. Do not send your password, OTP, full card number or banking credentials.

faq.q: Which worksheet should I start with?
faq.a: For a learner beginning letter tracing, try the free Alphabet A and B sheets first. Choose the next activity according to the child’s current skills and comfort, rather than age alone.

faq.q: What are the seven Kindergarten Alphabet sections?
faq.a: They are A–Z Letter Tracing, A–Z Letter Recognition, Match Uppercase and Lowercase Letters, Letters Before and After, Beginning Sounds, Ending Sounds, and Find the Missing Letters.

faq.q: What is in an A–Z tracing sheet?
faq.a: Each letter has a one-page A4 sheet with uppercase and lowercase examples, numbered tracing guides, a picture cue and dotted practice rows.

faq.q: What are letter-recognition sheets?
faq.a: The Colour the letter sheets ask children to find the target uppercase and lowercase letter in a grid and colour the matching letters.

faq.q: What do uppercase-and-lowercase matching sheets do?
faq.a: They show capital letters on one side and small letters on the other. Children trace the dotted line to connect each matching pair.

faq.q: What are beginning-sound activities?
faq.a: The current listings include writing a missing beginning sound, circling a pictured word’s starting sound, and finding words with the same beginning sound.

faq.q: What are ending-sound activities?
faq.a: The current listings include choosing or writing a pictured word’s ending sound and finding words with the same ending sound.

faq.q: What are missing-letter activities?
faq.a: Children fill gaps in alphabet sequences. The uploaded collection includes uppercase and lowercase versions using apples, an alphabet path, or short rows with pictures.

faq.q: Which picture-reading letters are listed?
faq.a: The uploaded picture-reading charts cover A, I, N, P, S and T. Each chart uses pictures and words to help a child spot the letter’s sound.

faq.q: Are sight words, vocabulary and grammar shown?
faq.a: Those skill categories appear in the site’s topic structure. Some sections have no ready worksheets and are marked Coming soon. Check the selected topic before assuming a resource can be opened or bought.

faq.q: Are CVC or digraph books available in this shop?
faq.a: The site mentions phonics topics and includes testimonials about CVC and digraph books. The confirmed ready collection in the uploaded build consists of the Kindergarten English worksheet listings. Ask support about book availability rather than assuming a testimonial is a current product listing.

faq.q: How long should a child practise?
faq.a: The website suggests short daily practice. Start with one comfortable activity and stop when the child becomes tired or frustrated; adjust to the learner’s needs.

faq.q: Which worksheets suit a five-year-old?
faq.a: If the child is beginning to recognise or trace letters, try the free A and B tracing sheets, letter recognition, matching, or simple sound activities. Tell me what the child can already do so I can suggest a more suitable next step.

faq.q: What can this assistant help me with?
faq.a: I can explain the listed worksheets, free samples, account steps, subscriptions, checkout and support options. Account-specific payment or access questions require verified information from your account or support.

faq.q: Can you read an uploaded image or PDF?
faq.a: The assistant bundled with this website says it cannot read attachments yet. Describe your question in words or contact support if a document needs review.

faq.q: Can I speak my question?
faq.a: The chat interface includes a Speak your question control. Availability depends on browser support and microphone permission; you can always type your message instead.

faq.q: Can I close the chat and return to the website?
faq.a: Yes. Use Close chat in the chat header and reopen it from the assistant button when needed.

faq.q: How much does a worksheet cost?
faq.a: Open the worksheet card and checkout for the current price. Paid ready sheets in this build have a default reference price of ₹19, but website or server pricing can override it; the checkout quote is authoritative.
alt: What is the price of a PDF?

faq.q: How much does a subscription cost?
faq.a: Select Kindergarten and your plan in the Subscription view. Use the current server-generated checkout quote for the price, currency, taxes and any discount; static reference prices are not a guaranteed offer.
alt: What are the plan prices?

faq.q: Can I pay in a currency other than INR?
faq.a: The website supports country-based checkout pricing and currency selection. Your actual currency and payable amount must come from the current checkout quote.

faq.q: Are taxes included in the displayed total?
faq.a: Review the live order summary for the final total and tax treatment. The uploaded India checkout mentions INR pricing with GST; do not infer a specific tax rate from these files.

faq.q: Which payment methods can I use?
faq.a: The interface includes Razorpay options such as cards, UPI and wallets, with Stripe and PayPal integration paths. Use only methods enabled on your current checkout page; the files alone do not confirm that every gateway is live.
alt: Can I pay with Razorpay, Stripe or PayPal?

faq.q: Can I use UPI?
faq.a: UPI options are included in the Razorpay checkout interface. Check whether UPI is enabled for your country and current order on the live payment page.

faq.q: Can I pay by card?
faq.a: Card payment options are included in the checkout interface. Available card networks and gateways depend on the live payment configuration.

faq.q: Why is payment marked Coming soon?
faq.a: The website shows that state when online payment is unavailable in the current configuration. Contact support for assistance rather than treating a disabled button as a successful payment.

faq.q: What happens if I cancel checkout?
faq.a: Cancelling before a completed charge should leave the purchase incomplete. Check your payment app or bank if you are unsure whether money was debited; a cancelled popup alone is not proof of your bank transaction status.

faq.q: My payment failed. What should I do?
faq.a: Check the payment message and your bank or payment-app transaction status. If money was debited, contact support with the payment reference before making a second payment.

faq.q: Money was deducted but the worksheet is locked. What should I do?
faq.a: Sign in to the account used for purchase and check My Worksheets and the order confirmation. If it remains locked, contact support with your registered email and payment reference. Access depends on verified payment status.

faq.q: Is my payment successful?
faq.a: I need verified order information to confirm your payment. Check the purchase confirmation and your account, or contact support with the order reference.

faq.q: Can I get a refund?
faq.a: The supplied website files do not establish a refund policy. Contact learnwithwhy6@gmail.com with your order details so the team can confirm the applicable terms.

faq.q: Can I cancel my subscription?
faq.a: The uploaded interface mentions cancellation but does not establish the cancellation process, refund rules or automatic-renewal behaviour. Contact support for the applicable terms.

faq.q: Does my subscription renew automatically?
faq.a: Automatic renewal is not confirmed in the supplied files. Check your checkout agreement and current account settings, or ask support.

faq.q: When does my plan expire?
faq.a: Open your account and check the subscription end date shown for your class plan. I need verified account information to give your exact expiry date and time.

faq.q: Is my subscription active?
faq.a: Check the subscription status in your account. I can only confirm it if the website supplies verified current account data.

faq.q: Why is a worksheet locked?
faq.a: A sheet may require a purchase or active class plan, or you may be signed in to a different account. Check your current entitlements and plan expiry; contact support if verified access is missing.

faq.q: Do individually purchased PDFs expire?
faq.a: Yes. A PDF you buy stays open for a set number of hours from the moment you pay (24 unless the shop says otherwise). My Account → My Worksheets shows a timer with the time left, and when it reaches zero the sheet is removed from your account. You can buy it again from the shop. The timer controls opening the sheet on this website. Pages you have already printed or downloaded stay with you, because a copy on a device or on paper cannot be removed from here.

faq.q: How many times can I print a worksheet?
faq.a: Each sheet you can open comes with its own prints, set by the account type you choose after signing up: Parent 2 prints, Teacher 4 prints, Organization 300 prints. The viewer shows how many prints are left on each sheet.
alt: Do parents get two prints and teachers four?

faq.q: Can I use my own phone and laptop?
faq.a: The current purchase copy permits opening sheets on devices where you sign in. Any future device restrictions must be checked against the current account policy; changing devices or networks alone does not prove password sharing.

faq.q: Can I share my sign-in code?
faq.a: No. Keep your codes private: a code lets someone into your account. If someone else needs access, ask support about the correct licence or a separate account. Never send a code to the assistant.

faq.q: Can I contact you on WhatsApp or Instagram?
faq.a: The uploaded site mentions WhatsApp and Instagram testimonials, but a verified support number or official social profile URL was not established. Use learnwithwhy6@gmail.com or the contact form.

faq.q: When will new worksheets be released?
faq.a: The website marks some sections Coming soon but gives no confirmed release dates. Contact support for the latest availability.
